printSheet.step1Desc: Input periodic unit or oral assessment scores per concept. Fast, zero-lag offline local storage.
printSheet.step2Desc: Scores below 60% automatically flag as gaps with clear, deterministic root causes (e.g. remainder confusion).

printSheet.caseStudyHeading: Real Classroom Case Study: Aarav Patel (Class 4-A)
printSheet.caseStudyBody: Aarav struggled with remainders in division (baseline 35%). The teacher implemented the 5-step concrete plan using 14 beads and 3 bowls for 15 minutes daily. On Day 4 formative reassessment, Aarav scored 85%, closing the gap.
printSheet.tip1Body: Use local pebbles, seeds, and matchsticks.
printSheet.tip4Body: Works without school Wi-Fi or data connection.
printSheet.footerKeepNote: Printable Reference Sheet • Keep at Teacher Desk
